explained.summary: Study what drives people, even the wise: what they steer clear of and what they go after. Marcus suggests you learn most about someone’s mind, their “ruling principle”, from their choices about what to pursue and avoid, and that this is worth studying carefully.
explained.today: Watch how a respected manager handles a mistake, or what a calm friend refuses to get drawn into. What they won’t chase or argue about tells you more than any advice they give.
